title: Route services NIP-34 repository discovery through advertised NIP-34 relays
observed_behavior: The Services route repository picker queried kind 30617 repository announcements through the global Bahia relay pool, which could resolve to the browser sidecar only.
The relay sidecar rejected kind 30617 reads with CLOSED reason: blocked: event kind 30617 is not readable from the Bahia sidecar.
intended_behavior: Repository announcement discovery uses configured nostr.nip34_relays when present without replacing the global Bahia singleton relay connection.
NIP-34 repository state lookups continue to use selected repository relays tag values for scoped 30618 filters.

The Bahia sidecar accepts all NIP-34 collaboration kinds from the local NIP-34 spec, plus NIP-22 comments used for NIP-34 replies, as open interop data so deployments can advertise the sidecar as a NIP-34 relay.
out_of_scope: Service secrets ContextVM method-not-found behavior from the same console log; track separately if it remains reproducible after this fix.
